TREE: AmbienteDirect is a multi-brand German design retailer that merchandises by PRODUCT TYPE (Furniture / Lighting / Accessories / High-Tech / Textiles / Outdoor / Classics) with a parallel SHOP-BY-ROOM layer (/en/living-room, /en/bedroom, /en/nursery, /en/hallway, /en/office, /en/kitchen-dining-room, /en/bathroom). There is NO 'Bathroom' top-level product category and no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, taps or toilets anywhere on the site. Three independent sources were walked and cross-checked: (1) the full mega-menu on the homepage and on every PLP (263 links harvested, complete category tree, no truncation - the same tree appears identically on the homepage, on /en/bathroom and on the bath-accessories PLP); (2) https://www.ambientedirect.com/sitemap_categories_en.xml (183 category URLs) and its German twin sitemap_categories_de.xml (183 URLs) - grepped for bath|mirror|shower|towel|soap|toilet|wc|basin|sink|tap|faucet and for the German bad|badezimmer|spiegel|dusch|wasch|handtuch|seife; (3) https://www.ambientedirect.com/sitemap_filter_pages_en.xml (135 URLs) and sitemap_filter_pages_de.xml (1093 URLs), plus sitemap_other_en.xml (2432 URLs). The Bathroom branch is therefore defined by the site's own /en/bathroom room page tile strip, which links exactly nine nodes: Laundry baskets, Mirrors, Bathroom lighting, Shelves and towel ladders, Hooks, Container, Bath towels, Bath mats, Bath accessories. Of those, two are recorded as Bathroom leaves, five are in review[] with reasons, and 'Container' (https://www.ambientedirect.com/en/categories/furniture/containers) is excluded as general Furniture - it is ALREADY EXTRACTED IN Furniture.xlsx as 'Containers' (exact index hit). No parent row was recorded: Bath accessories and Bathroom shelves and towel ladders have no category children (their only sub-URLs in the DE filter sitemap are colour facets - /badaccessoires/schwarz, /badaccessoires/gold - which are facets, not subcategories, and were not recorded, per rule 24 + BATCH_BRIEF s3). QTY: every figure is the listing page's own rendered total or an exhaustive on-page enumeration - nothing estimated, nothing inferred, nothing aggregated. AmbienteDirect renders PLPs server-side with a progress bar '<div role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="38" aria-valuemax="278">' plus the visible string '38 of 278 products'. Where a category fits on one page the progress element carries class 'hide' and the Load more anchor carries class 'hide', which means the complete grid is already in the HTML; those totals were obtained by counting .snippetProductsListStandard__item nodes that contain an <a href> matching _pid_ (dummy grid-filler items excluded). Bath accessories = 278 (aria-valuemax=278, text '38 of 278 products'). Bathroom shelves and towel ladders = 15 (single-page, exhaustive card count). VERIFICATION: (a) the card-counting method was calibrated against the rendered totals - on bath-accessories the counter returns 38 against aria-valuenow=38, on mirrors 40 against 40, on hallwaymirrors 40 against 40, i.e. exact agreement on three pages of differing size, so the same counter is trustworthy on the single-page nodes. (b) Pagination proof for the 278: ?spot2%5Bp%5D=1 returns 'aria-valuenow=78 aria-valuemax=278' / '78 of 278 products' (cumulative +40), and ?spot2%5Bp%5D=6 returns a 40-card fragment, i.e. 38 + 40x6 = 278 exactly, so the rendered total reconciles with enumeration to exhaustion. (c) Counts discriminate per node - 278 / 151 / 136 / 73 / 33 / 19 / 15 / 12 / 1, no site-wide constant and no round-number cap. (d) H1/canonical checked on every page: 'Bath accessories' (canonical .../accessories/bath-accessories), 'Bathroom shelves and towel ladders' (canonical .../furniture/shelves/bathroomshelves-towelladders), 'Mirrors', 'Hallway mirrors', 'Bathroom lighting', 'Kitchen & bath towels', 'Bath mats' - all self-canonical, so BATCH_BRIEF blind spot (a) canonical-alias laundering does not apply. DEDUP: already_extracted() was run on every candidate leaf AND on every locale alternate declared in each page's hreflang set, including the cross-HOST Dutch alternates on www.ambientedirect.nl (blind spot (c)). Results: accessories/mirrors = HARD HIT (Final.xlsx, 'Mirrors') -> review[], not rows[]. Everything else misses: /en/categories/accessories/bath-accessories and its de /kategorien/accessoires/badaccessoires, fr /fr/rubriques/accessoires/accessoires-salles-de-bains and nl https://www.ambientedirect.nl/categorieen/accessoires/badkameraccessoires all miss; the same four-locale check on mirrors shows only the en form indexed. The index holds 70 ambientedirect.com URLs - 44 from Furniture.xlsx (the whole Furniture and Outdoor furniture branch) and 26 from Final.xlsx (Lighting, Decoration, Kitchenware and Mirrors).
